metrics_finding.finding: inventory-service CPU utilization increased significantly during the failure window, from 0.00924 to 0.6572566666666667, indicating a potential resource overload.

evidence_summary.summary: Inventory service CPU utilization increased significantly during the failure window, indicating a potential resource overload.

report.suggested_fix: Monitor inventory service CPU utilization and adjust resource allocation as needed to prevent future overloads.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be a resource overload in the inventory service. Monitoring CPU utilization and adjusting resource allocation can help prevent similar incidents in the future.
report_text.hi: क्षेत्रीय घटना के मुख्य कारण संदेह है कि इनवेंट्री सेवा में संसाधनों की अधिकता। इनवेंट्री सेवा की CPU उपयोग की निगरानी करना और आवश्यकतानुसार संसाधनों को व्यवस्थित करने से भविष्य में समान घटनाओं को रोकने में मदद मिल सकती है।
